packageRules.description: Patch/minor bumps are safe to roll out unattended — the weekly VM update run (scripts/update-containers.sh) takes a fresh backup and health-checks before/after.
Major bumps (e.g. postgres 17->18) can mean incompatible on-disk data or breaking changes — always reviewed manually, never auto-merged.
Confluence minor releases run database upgrade tasks and regularly break installed apps; only patch releases roll out unattended, minors get a PR for manual review.
